items.title: Call of Duty Ranked Levels: Every Skill Division and What Carries Into a New Title
items.content:
Call of Duty ranked levels in mainline multiplayer Ranked Play run from Bronze to a Top 250 leaderboard finish. Black Ops 7 treats a new season differently depending on whether you finished below Platinum, and a new title begins its own progression. Warzone and Call of Duty Mobile have separate ranked systems.
The Eight Ladder Positions, In Order
Black Ops 7 Ranked Play has seven named Skill Divisions that group players by rank, followed by Top 250, a place on the leaderboard for the highest-ranked competitors. In order, the eight ladder positions are Bronze, Silver, Gold, Platinum, Diamond, Crimson, Iridescent, and Top 250. Top 250 is a leaderboard position rather than another ordinary division to grind through. As a new player, you’ll receive a starting rank only after winning the required placement matches.
This is the Black Ops 7 multiplayer ladder; Warzone and Call of Duty Mobile use their own ranked systems.
Players in the Bronze division through Gold keep their rank and SR when a new season starts, but players in Platinum and above need a placement win. Rank is only part of what a profile carries, though: building one from scratch with the level, weapons, and camos you want takes a long run of matches. Players who would rather start from a finished profile can browse Call of Duty accounts on Skycoach, a marketplace where each Black Ops 7, Modern Warfare 4, or Warzone account listing shows whether it is ranked-ready, along with its level, Prestige, camo count, weapons, and the platforms it links to (PC, PlayStation, or Xbox). Skycoach has operated since 2020, and purchases come with buyer protection: a warranty period, a refund policy, and 24/7 support.
Where SR Actually Comes From
The gold Champion operator skin in Black Ops 7 Ranked Play art from Season 04. Source: Activision
Black Ops 7 starts with placements. You must win three placement matches to receive a starting rank, and after each placement win, the Minimum Starting Rank updates to show a projection of where you’re expected to land.
After a Ranked Play win, you gain Skill Rating (SR), which sets your position on the ladder. The amount isn’t fixed: it depends on your match performance relative to the skill of the other players and the team’s margin of victory. The same factors affect SR deducted after a loss. As Activision’s ranked support page explains, the SR change depends on these match factors, so two wins during the same evening can award different amounts without an error in the display.
Black Ops 7 also expects you to win more often as your SR rises. According to Activision, this can mean smaller SR gains and larger losses at higher ranks, especially near the Top 250 leaderboard. A win in one lobby may move your rating less than a win in another. The post-match summary breaks down the SR gained or lost in each match, so you can see which factors affected that result.
A bad night lowers your visible SR, but it says little about whether your overall climb has stalled. To get a clearer picture, record the SR before and after several matches, including losses. The longer sample gives you more insight than pushing harder through one frustrating session.
What A New Season Resets, And What It Leaves Alone
In Black Ops 7, a new season doesn’t send every ranked player back to Bronze (Season 06, The Haunting, went live on September 17, 2026). Bronze, Silver, and Gold players retain both their rank and SR. But Platinum players and above must win one placement match to receive a rank and begin the new season (refer to the table above to see the dividing line).
If you end the season in the Gold division, your rank and SR simply carry over. If you finish in Diamond, you must win one placement match before receiving a rank for the new season.
The one-win requirement for Platinum and above is different from the three placement wins required when a Black Ops 7 player is initially Unranked. It also doesn’t guarantee a return to the exact rank held last season. If you finish in Diamond, your old Diamond badge records where you ended, and the new season’s rank appears after your placement win. Black Ops 7 provides SR loss protection for the first three losses of a new season, but that protection begins after placement matches.
Rewards are another reason to care about the finish rather than only the restart. For Season 06, Activision lists an animated “Ranked Season 06 – Top 250” calling card and animated weapon camo as rewards for finishing Top 250. The single player who finishes #1 overall gets a distinct “Ranked Season 06 – Top 250 Champion” animated calling card. Keep a reward earned for a finish separate from the division shown on the next season’s first day.
What Happens When A New Call of Duty Lands
Modern Warfare 4 begins its own ranked progression, separate from Black Ops 7. Source: Activision
Modern Warfare 4, developed by Infinity Ward, launched on Friday, October 23, 2026, for PlayStation 5, Xbox Series X and S, Nintendo Switch 2, and PC through Battle.net, Xbox on PC, and Steam. Black Ops 7 is a Treyarch title with its own multiplayer progression, so a Top 250 finish there won’t give you a starting rank in Modern Warfare 4.
In Modern Warfare 4, there are two Prestige paths:
Regular Prestige returns the player to Level 1 while retaining level unlocks and Create-a-Class content.
Classic Prestige resets level unlocks and Create-a-Class progression in exchange for increased XP rates and exclusive rewards. Both paths have their own milestones and rewards.
Prestige is a level progression choice within Modern Warfare 4, separate from the Ranked Play position earned in Black Ops 7. Neither option is a method for bringing a Black Ops 7 rank into the new game.
Within Modern Warfare 4, weapon progression also reduces repeat work: unlock an attachment once, and you get more options as you move from weapon to weapon. The official multiplayer blog sets out the Prestige paths and confirms the October 23 launch date.
Many unconfirmed lists circulated ahead of the launch about what would transfer and what wouldn’t. Activision confirmed the release date, its own progression design, and the two Prestige paths. It did not provide a comprehensive publisher-confirmed list establishing that every Black Ops 7 weapon, attachment, camo, or ranked unlock would transfer into Modern Warfare 4. Some pre-order benefits were explicitly described as available in both titles, but that doesn’t establish a general carryover rule for earned items. For what comes next in the new title, see our Modern Warfare 4 roadmap and Season 1 coverage. Check a specific reward against an Activision statement before planning around it.
The Numbers Nobody Can Actually Check
Community discussions regularly assign percentages to Gold, Platinum, or Diamond. Those figures can sound precise, but Activision’s Black Ops 7 ranked support information doesn’t publish a division-by-division player distribution. Without a publisher dataset, a claim such as “Diamond is the top X percent” is an estimate, not a measurable fact about the whole player base. Screenshots of a leaderboard also cannot settle the question. They show a small group of visible ranks, not the count of every player who entered placements or played during a season.
What you can actually measure is your own SR movement across a set number of matches, your placement projection, and where you finished last season. Tracking this shows whether your climb is improving, how volatile your SR gains feel at a particular rank, and whether a late promotion is realistic on the time available. Warzone and Call of Duty Mobile need their own records, since neither uses the Black Ops 7 multiplayer ladder.
If you’re deciding whether the rest of the Black Ops 7 season is worth the hours, keep this in mind: Bronze through Gold keep their rank and SR at the turnover, Platinum and above need one new placement win, and Modern Warfare 4, out since October 23, has its own separate progression.
The post Call of Duty Ranked Levels: Every Skill Division and What Carries Into a New Title appeared first on TalkEsport.

Alice Huang’s husband, a video game investor, introduced her to Jensen Huang, report suggests
items.content:
Jensen Huang was introduced to Alice Huang by her own husband, according to a new report by the Wall Street Journal’s Lingling Wei. The husband, a Chinese businessman, had known the Nvidia chief executive for about a decade before making the introduction. When the two men first met in the 2010s, he was a private equity investor focused on video game companies, at a time when Nvidia was still best known for PC gaming graphics cards.
The Journal reports that he is also Alice Huang’s business partner, and that he appeared to accept her romantic relationship with Huang. According to people familiar with the couple, he spoke openly about her closeness to the Nvidia chief.
The report adds a new layer to a scandal that has already put Huang’s job at risk. Huang admitted to an affair in a letter to staff on 8 November, without naming the person involved. Reports have since linked him to Alice Huang, a former executive at the Singapore firm Megaspeed, whom US intelligence reportedly suspects of gathering information for China. Nvidia’s board is reportedly preparing to remove him, although it has not announced a decision, and no charges have been reported against Alice Huang.
The introduction came out of Nvidia’s gaming years
The Journal’s account places the start of the story in the games business. According to the report, the husband got to know Huang while investing in video game companies, years before Nvidia’s data centre chips made it the most valuable chip company in the world. Over the past decade, the couple then moved between business ventures in video game companies, pharmaceutical takeovers and cloud computing, the Journal says. The report does not give an exact date for when Huang and Alice Huang first met.
Video games also run through the wider Megaspeed story. Megaspeed, where Alice Huang worked, was set up in Singapore in 2023 as an offshore unit of 7Road, according to a New York Times investigation. The parent company is a Chinese games and cloud firm, best known for browser games such as DDTank and Wartune. That background, along with its purchases of billions of dollars of Nvidia hardware, is part of why Megaspeed sits at the centre of the scandal. The Journal’s report does not link the husband to Megaspeed or 7Road.
TalkEsport is not naming the husband, who is a private individual, although the Journal identifies him. The report relies on people familiar with the couple, and TalkEsport has not found any public comment from him or from Alice Huang. Nvidia previously described Huang’s interactions with Alice Huang as “not unusual”, saying he meets thousands of customer executives every year. Beijing has rejected the espionage claims as smears against China.
Nvidia’s Singapore revenue line disappeared after Megaspeed was blocklisted
A second Wall Street Journal piece, by columnist Jonathan Weil, looks at Nvidia’s own disclosures. According to Weil, Nvidia stopped reporting its Singapore revenue after the quarter that ended in July 2025, when the country accounted for 22% of its total revenue. That change came after Nvidia placed Megaspeed on a blocklist, the Journal reports. Nvidia’s financial filings report revenue by the customer’s billing location, so revenue billed to Singapore does not necessarily mean chips were shipped there.
The chip trail has also grown since the scandal broke. This week, The Information reported that Alice Huang was linked to Shanghai Century Litong, a Chinese Nvidia cloud partner that it says helped move at least $7.5 billion of Nvidia chips into China since 2023. Reuters said it could not verify that report. Megaspeed itself broke its silence on Thursday with a statement saying it has hired a US law firm to count its GPUs and check its export compliance, without mentioning Nvidia or Huang.
The fallout is already reaching Nvidia’s customers in China. Chinese AI companies are rushing to rent Nvidia-powered computing capacity at data centres outside China, Reuters reported on Thursday, amid fears that Washington will tighten restrictions after the scandal. Inside Nvidia, the Financial Times reported that employees known for their loyalty to Huang were left stunned, and some angry, by the news of his affairs. That contrasts with a Blind poll taken before the second affair report, in which 88% of Nvidia staff who answered said he should stay.
Nvidia’s board still has to decide what the affair means for Huang
The board’s central question is whether Huang’s relationship created a security or governance problem for the company. In a statement after the first reports, the board said it had “no reason to believe” that national security or Nvidia’s secrets had been compromised. It has since hired former federal prosecutor Joon Kim and the law firm Wachtell Lipton to investigate, and it has not said what the investigation covers beyond Huang’s conduct. Under Nvidia’s bylaws, a majority of its 11 directors can remove the chief executive with or without cause, and Huang owns around 3.6% of the company.
The pressure on the board is rising by the day. Nvidia shares closed at $173.73 on Wednesday, then fell 7.25% to $161.13 in after-hours trading as reports spread that directors were preparing to act. The company’s possible successors have already been discussed publicly, with chief financial officer Colette Kress reported as the leading interim option. Nvidia is due to report its third-quarter results on 17 November.

items.title: GTA 6 Release Time for All Regions: When GTA 6 Unlocks Worldwide
items.content:
Grand Theft Auto VI unlocks at midnight local time on 19 November in every region, on both PS5 and Xbox Series X|S. Rockstar Games is using a rolling regional release rather than a single global launch. New Zealand is first, at 11:00 UTC on 18 November. The US West Coast is last, at 08:00 UTC on 19 November, a gap of 21 hours.
GTA 6 release time by region: IST, ET, PT, GMT and more
The table shows when GTA VI unlocks in major cities, in local time and in UTC. Players in the same time zone as a listed city get the game at the same moment. In India, the game unlocks at 12:00 AM IST on 19 November, matching the PlayStation and Xbox India store listings.
The UTC times are our calculations based on midnight in each city, using standard time for 19 November. Countries that span several time zones, such as Australia, Brazil, Mexico and the US, unlock at local midnight in each zone. Rockstar has not published an official city-by-city unlock table.
How the GTA 6 regional unlock works on PS5 and Xbox
The game unlocks automatically for players who pre-ordered digitally and finished the pre-load. Pre-loading opened on 10 November, and the game needs up to 212 GB of free space, as Rockstar’s pre-load FAQ states. Players who have not pre-loaded must download the full game after it unlocks. That can take hours on slower connections, as we covered in our report on GTA 6 pre-load times and file size.
Retail boxes contain a download code rather than a disc. Owners of physical editions still need to download the game, and Rockstar has not said whether any stores will open at midnight. GTA VI is available only on PS5 and Xbox Series X|S at launch. Xbox One owners can play through Xbox Cloud Gaming, as we covered in our report on GTA 6 coming to Xbox One through the cloud.
Some players plan to switch their console region to New Zealand to start 21 hours earlier. Rockstar has not commented on the practice. The method differs between PS5 and Xbox, as we covered in our report on playing GTA 6 early with the New Zealand trick. Rockstar has not announced a PC version or a PC release date.
GTA 6 release time FAQ
What time does GTA 6 come out? GTA VI unlocks at 12:00 AM local time on 19 November 2026 in each region. It goes live first in New Zealand at 11:00 UTC on 18 November and last on the US West Coast at 08:00 UTC on 19 November.
What time does GTA 6 release in India? GTA VI unlocks at 12:00 AM IST on Thursday, 19 November, on PS5 and Xbox Series X|S. The Standard Edition costs ₹5,999 and the Ultimate Edition ₹7,499, as we covered in our report on what it costs to play GTA 6 in India.
Does GTA 6 release at the same time on PS5 and Xbox? Yes. Both consoles unlock the game at midnight local time on 19 November. Only the pre-load start times differed between the two platforms.
What time does GTA 6 release in the UK and US? GTA VI unlocks at 12:00 AM GMT on 19 November in the UK. In the US, it unlocks at midnight in each time zone, from 05:00 UTC on the East Coast to 08:00 UTC on the West Coast.
Full edition details are on the official GTA VI website. GTA VI launches on PS5 and Xbox Series X|S on 19 November.
The post GTA 6 Release Time for All Regions: When GTA 6 Unlocks Worldwide appeared first on TalkEsport.

items.title: Sky Esports Win G2 x PUBG MOBILE Community Challenge on a Dust II-Inspired Map, Undisputed
items.content:
Amateur squad Sky Esports has won the G2 x PUBG MOBILE Community Challenge, a tournament played on a custom map inspired by Counter-Strike’s Dust II inside PUBG MOBILE. The team beat Star Dust Esports 2-0 in the best-of-three grand final over the weekend of 7 and 8 November, and took home €500 in cash, a €125 Amazon gift card and G2 merchandise.
Twenty-five teams entered the event, which was open only to amateur players and ran in a round-based bomb-defusal mode rather than PUBG MOBILE’s usual battle royale. The winners are not to be confused with Skyesports, the Indian tournament organiser.
Sky Esports did not lose a match all weekend
The tournament opened on Saturday with best-of-one, single-elimination qualifiers, which left no room for an off day. With 25 teams chasing four semi-final places, a single defeat ended a team’s weekend. Sky Esports, WM Officials, Star Dust Esports and DMSXBIS came through to claim those slots. On Sunday, both semi-finals were played as best-of-three series, and both ended 2-0, with Sky Esports beating WM Officials and Star Dust Esports knocking out DMSXBIS.
The grand final was just as one-sided as the semi-finals. Sky Esports took the opening map and then won the second 6-1 to complete a 2-0 series win, according to the organisers. In the third-place match, played alongside the final, DMSXBIS beat WM Officials to finish on the podium. That means Sky Esports won every match it played across the two days, from the single-elimination qualifiers to the final.
Every team in the top four left with a prize. The cash prizes add up to the €1,000 prize pool that G2’s community account advertised when registration opened on 27 October. On top of that, the top three teams each received a €125 Amazon gift card and G2 merchandise, while fourth place took €125 in gift cards.
A Dust II remake inside PUBG MOBILE is G2’s pitch to Counter-Strike players
The custom map was the event’s main hook for Counter-Strike fans. Called PMG2, it was built in World of Wonder, the creation mode in PUBG MOBILE that lets players and partners design their own maps and game modes. Its layout is inspired by Dust II, one of the best-known maps in Counter-Strike’s history. To keep the Counter-Strike feel, teams played a classic bomb-defusal mode in which each player had a single life per match, according to the organisers.
G2 and PUBG MOBILE said the event was designed to connect with Western Europe’s large Counter-Strike community and to introduce G2 fans to the mobile game. G2 is one of the most recognisable names in Counter-Strike, and its roster has included stars such as m0NESY, who played his first full season with G2 in 2022 before joining Falcons. The organisers described the Dust II-style map as a bridge between the familiar world of Counter-Strike and the mobile battle royale.
Restricting entry to amateurs also gave smaller teams a competitive stage of their own. All four semi-finalists entered as amateur teams, in line with the event’s rules, and the prize structure rewarded every team in the top four. The format put accessibility ahead of a large prize pool, which suits an event built to bring new players into the game.
The Community Challenge sits inside a bigger PUBG MOBILE push in Western Europe
The tournament is the latest project in a partnership that G2 and PUBG MOBILE Esports announced in Berlin on 15 June. Under that deal, G2’s media house, 62, supports tournament operations and community activations, while German creator JanickaGaming was named PUBG MOBILE’s ambassador for the region, with weekly streams of the game. “It still feels like we’re only scratching the surface of what’s possible here,” G2 chief executive Alban Dechelotte said at the time. Shaowei Chen, PUBG MOBILE’s head of Western Europe publishing, called the region “one of the most promising growth frontiers for PUBG MOBILE esports”.
The partnership’s first major event was the 2026 PUBG MOBILE Global Open Western Europe Finals in September, organised by 62. According to the official results, 16 teams played 18 matches for a $23,000 prize pool, and British team Hustler Crew won with 157 points and 109 eliminations. Hustler Crew and Ukraine’s NEXT qualified for the PMGO Season 2 main event in Pakistan, which Wolves Esports went on to win.
The pathway also includes the PUBG MOBILE Club Open Western Europe, which the partners launched alongside the June announcement as an amateur-to-pro route. PUBG MOBILE, which is co-developed by Tencent’s Lightspeed Studios and Krafton, is also widening its reach with PUBG MOBILE FLASH, a lighter version of the game due on 13 November. At the top of the competitive ladder, PMGO is one of the routes to the PUBG MOBILE Global Championship, whose 2026 field is now set.

items.title: Vindictus: Defying Fate comes to PS5 next year
items.content:
Hello, PlayStation players. I’m Dongseok Oh, lead director of the high-octane action-RPG Vindictus: Defying Fate.
Our team is building a medieval fantasy adventure where heroes must stand against colossal foes in a world inspired by Celtic mythology and, today, we’re officially revealing that Vindictus: Defying Fate is coming to PS5.
I’m honored to have this opportunity to introduce the core gameplay and world to the PlayStation community.
Play Video
Fight beautifully
Visceral, engaging combat is key to the Vindictus: Defying Fate experience. So much so, that weapons are the first step when we conceptualize our heroes. We carefully consider a wide range of weapons, from familiar ones players expect to see to more unconventional options that offer unique and exciting combat possibilities, and choose one as the foundation.
Our teams behind narrative, combat actions, and appearance are given freedom to explore their own designs and express their creativity before the overall direction is established, crafting a hero with a distinct combat style. Who you choose to play will yield an entirely different experience. You can devote yourself to the one hero who captures your heart, or develop several heroes and choose the right one as the situation demands.
Lann: Relies on dodging rather than guarding. Chain dodges to avoid attacks, then close in for a strike immediately after landing a hit.
Fiona: Uses her shield to block and counterattack, balancing offense and defense. Deflect an enemy attack with precise timing to continue your own attack without interruption.
If you hope to withstand combat in this harsh world, you will need intense focus and precise control. Survival means learning how your enemies move.
Depending on your chosen hero’s abilities, you can parry a crushing blow, block a brutal barrage of attacks, or dodge at just the right moment. The key is to create an opening and strike back with a heavy counterattack.
Delia: Builds up power to unleash a devastating blow. She can also evade attacks by piercing through an enemy as she strikes.
Karok: Absorbs the impact of incoming attacks to stand his ground. Time your response to a powerful enemy attack to enter a contest of strength.
You also craft your own weapons, customizing your outfits and appearance to make your hero uniquely yours.
Prophecy and the mercenaries
“The gates of paradise shall open when one race eradicates the other.”
Ruled by this fateful prophecy, the Humans and Fomors of Taranúil have long soaked the land in each other’s blood.
You must face your fate as a new recruit of the Kalbram Mercenaries, working under the Rocheste Order. As you set out on your journey, you’ll uncover a shadowy plot hiding beneath old conflicts.
As you explore the world of Vindictus, you’ll encounter breathtaking lands still touched by the breath of ancient gods, and thriving centers of human culture that have blossomed even amid war.
Every step across this uncharted continent reveals a new landscape, yet the same reality awaits: war against the Fomors. From Fomors hostile to humankind to ferocious beasts, all manner of enemies lie in wait.
Colhen: A small farming village on the front line, where human and Fomor territories meet.
Northern Ruins: Ancient ruins that once stood in neutral territory between humans and Fomors.
Hoarfrost Hollow: A valley of snow-covered forests, ice mines, and glacial waterfalls.
Ainle: A city destroyed overnight by a mysterious incident.
Facing threats together
This journey is, at its core, one you walk alone. We are also preparing multiplayer content that will let you face overwhelming threats alongside other players.
Defy your fate
The prophecy has already been spoken. Yet only a hero’s single step forward can rise above that fate.
Now, it’s your turn to defy it.
The PlayStation Store page for Vindictus: Defying Fate is now live and you can add the game to your wishlist.

items.title: Marathon’s massive Symbiosis update detailed in new ‘Gameplay Trailer’
items.content:
As an extraction shooter, Marathon features an interesting pool of maps, plenty of weapons to obtain / upgrade and a solid sense of progression. For many fans of Bungie however, the sole focus on PvPvE extraction has been a major deterrent, leading to less than stellar player numbers. Representing what is easily the game’s biggest update so far, the team have given us our first proper look at everything coming with the Symbiosis update next month – including a PvP deathmatch mode; map updates; a social hub; new runner; weapons and Marathon’s first permanent PvE mode.
Releasing their official Symbiosis Gameplay Trailer, the team at Bungie offered fans their first proper insight into the upcoming update which is scheduled to go live on the 8th of December. Though some of what was shown had been teased previously, we’ve now gotten a more comprehensive look at what to expect when Symbiosis launches in under a month’s time, which includes:
Perimeter Zone updates
Visual refresh
Expanded playable area
New underground area: Burrows
New location: Reservoir
Permanent PvE mode: Expedition
Features roguelite mechanics / randomised ‘Flash Boost’ upgrades
Includes escalating multi-run challenges
Concludes with a ‘Tick Queen’ boss fight
Social Space: LIMBO
Includes a firing range to test your gear / abilities
New Runner shell: Bishop
A “high-performance robot samurai”
Additional weapons and gear
Maverick pistol / handcannon
Throwing knife
Hack grenade
V17 flamethrower
PvP Deathmatch mode [beta]
While Marathon in its current state has failed to make a major splash on the market, the Symbiosis update looks to serve as almost a relaunch of sorts, offering far more than the original extraction experience (while still bringing new additions for players who prefer the PvPvE element of Marathon).
For those who remain sceptical, Bungie also announced that they will be hosting a free-to-play week to coincide with the upcoming update; running from the launch of Symbiosis on the 8th of December up until the 15th.
After stumbling quite badly out of the gate, it appears as though Bungie / Marathon is finally finding its footing. Hopefully the Symbiosis update will prove to be a success on all fronts.

Sony’s PS5 has officially sold over 100 million units
items.content:
The current console generation has been one of the weirdest, as unlike pretty much all past consoles, both the PS5 and Series X|S have seen significant price increases over the years. With regards to Sony’s system, this does not seem to have negatively impacted the PS5, with the console maker officially announcing that it has now surpassed 100 million units sold.
As part of the company’s latest earnings report, Sony offered updated sales stats for their current-gen PlayStation 5, revealing that as of the 10th of November 2026 the system has officially sold “more than 100 million” units.
It is worth noting that this figure accounts for ‘sell-in’ systems, meaning consoles which have been sold to retailers and not necessarily ‘sold-though’ to customers (though the two are likely to be closely aligned).
This puts the PS5 in a rather exclusive club, becoming only the 8th console in history – handhelds included – to reach such a milestone.
Whether the PlayStation 5 will surpass Sony’s last-gen PS4 and its 117 million units remains to be seen. That said, it is safe to assume that at the very least it will beat out the Nintendo Wii [101.63 million] and the OG PSOne [102.49 million] when all is said and done.
Launch-aligned, the PS5 is currently ever-so-slightly behind the last-gen PS4. As mentioned however, unlike the PlayStation 4 (which at this point in its life was going on sale for as low as £199), Sony’s current system will set you back a minimum of £519.99 for the digital edition – £160 more than its launch price of £359.99.
All that being said, with the industry-shaking Grand Theft Auto VI arriving in a week’s time, and PS5 Pros being out of stock at most retailers, there appears to still be quite a bit of demand for Sony’s latest and greatest. It will be interesting to see where the system will settle at, come the arrival of the PS6 in a few years’ time.

Digital game gifting is finally coming to the Nintendo Switch…with some limitations
items.content:
Though it has been a staple on the likes of Steam for well over a decade now, purchasing a digital game for your friend on consoles has been a tricky endeavour, with Xbox being the sole system to offer such functionality. Finally, it appears as though Nintendo is getting with the times, announcing that Switch users will soon be able to gift digital games to others – albeit with a catch.
Taking to their blog to make the announcement, Nintendo revealed that they will officially start to allow gifting games through their eShop come the 16th of November. Nintendo being Nintendo however, the feature does come with some caveats; namely the fact that you can only gift items to those who are part of your ‘Family Group’.
On the flip-side, with Nintendo being Nintendo, they’ve managed to bring an added element of ‘fun’ to the functionality. Upon purchasing a gift for your family member, users will be able to digitally wrap the present with a variety of different colours.
This also means that recipients will not know what they have been gifted until they ‘unwrap’ the present – adding a nice element of surprise to the mix.
Despite the relatively harsh limitations, it is welcome to see digital gifting finally coming to the Switch in any form. All that’s left now is for PlayStation to follow suit.

items.title: Sony has officially cancelled its unreleased live-service heist shooter ‘FairGame$’
items.content:
After spending years investing in almost a dozen different live-service titles, Sony has slowly but surely been back-tracking towards a focus on single-player offerings – leading to the cancellation of many different in-development projects. One game which seemed to have survived the culling was Haven Studios’ FairGame$. Three-and-a-half years on from its initial announcement however, Sony has now officially cancelled the project.
As reported by notable insider Jason Schreier via Bloomberg, Sony has officially cancelled the live-service PvP heist shooter FairGame$ three and a half years on from its initial announcement back in Summer of 2023.
While we had not seen anything from the game in an official capacity since its initial reveal trailer, various scoops from over the years did paint a rather worrying picture for FairGame$.
According to reports, playtests for the game were skewing negative; the founder of Haven Studios – Jade Raymond – had departed; with multiple game reworks failing to yield results. Most recently, it was claimed that FairGame$ would be rebranded and re-revealed entirely under the new name ‘Break In’. Ultimately, it seems all this was for naught, with the entire project now being canned.
The one silver lining in all this is the fact that according to Sony, the cancellation of FairGame$ is not being accompanied by any lay-offs, with a spokesperson claiming that: “The studio will shift its focus to collaborating with other development teams across PlayStation Studios, while also exploring new creative opportunities.”
While perhaps three-and-a-half years too late, cancelling FairGame$ / Break In is certainly preferable when compared to what may have ended up being another Concord.

items.title: Gen.G vs. BLG odds: Worlds 2026 finals betting and implied win chances
items.content:
Gen.G Esports are favorites over Bilibili Gaming (BLG) in the 2026 League of Legends (LoL) World Championship (Worlds) final on Nov. 14. Polymarket prices them at 63% to BLG’s 38%, while 1xBet and Stake imply about 61% to 62% once margin is removed.
Key takeaways
Polymarket prices Gen.G at 63% and BLG at 38%, with $600,000 in volume on the match winner market.
After removing margin, Gen.G is 62.4% on Polymarket, 60.6% at 1xBet, and 61.7% at Stake.
Of the two sportsbooks, Stake offers the longer BLG price (2.5 vs. 2.436). 1xBet offers the longer Gen.G price (1.584 vs. 1.55).
The teams are 2-2 head-to-head, lifetime.
All numbers were captured Nov. 12 and can move before the final.
Worlds 2026 finals betting odds: Gen.G vs. BLG
These are the lines captured Nov. 12. Decimal odds include your stake, so 1.55 returns 1.55 units for every unit wagered.
SourceGen.GBLGRaw chancesChances (margin removed)
Polymarket1.562.55GEN 64.1% : 39.2% BLGGEN 62.0% : 38.0% BLG
1xBet1.5842.436GEN 63.1% : 41.1% BLGGEN 60.6% : 39.4% BLG
Stake1.552.5GEN 64.5% : 40% BLGGEN 61.7% : 37.3% BLG
Each raw chance is 1 divided by the decimal odds. At 1xBet, 1 / 1.584 is 63.1% for Gen.G and 1 / 2.436 is 41.1% for BLG. Together they reach 104.2%, and the extra 4.2 points are the bookmaker’s margin.
Dividing each side by 104.2% removes the margin and leaves 60.6% for Gen.G and 39.4% for BLG. Stake’s raw figures are 64.5% and 40.0%, a total of 104.5%, which becomes 61.7% and 38.3%. This proportional method assumes the margin is spread evenly across both sides and may not be 100% reliable.
The same steps were used for Polymarket. 1 / 1.56 is 64.1% for Gen.G and 1 / 2.55 is 39.2% for BLG, a total of 103.3%. Removing the margin leaves 62.0% and 38.0%. The percent prices total 101%, which leaves 62.4% and 37.6%. It’s worth noting that when the numbers were captured, the platform displayed 63% for Gen.G.
Gen.G: two knockout sweeps and a first Worlds final
Gen.G swept LYON 3-0 on Nov. 5 and Invictus Gaming 3-0 on Nov. 7, meaning they have not dropped a single game in the Worlds 2026 Knockout stage.
Despite their long-time domestic dominance, this is Gen.G’s first Worlds final. More importantly, this is also the first for Jeong “Chovy” Ji-hoon, who reached it on his eighth Worlds appearance.
BLG: a 3-1 win over T1 and a 2-2 head-to-head
BLG ended T1′s four-peat attempt in the semifinal, 3-1, on Nov. 8. In their path to the Worlds 2026 Grand Final, they had to end T1’s undefeated streak against LPL teams in Worlds Knockout stages.
The head-to-head between BLG and Gen. G is level. BLG won at MSI and Worlds in 2023, and Gen.G won both the winners’ bracket final and the grand final at MSI 2024, each 3-1. This is the first time that the two teams will face each other this year.
Betting rules differ by region, and the Worlds 2026 grand finals odds may have moved since Nov. 12. Only wager what you can afford to lose. Bet responsibly.

Best Permanent Unlocks to spend Tokens on in Modern Warfare 4
items.content:
Classic Prestige has returned in Call of Duty: Modern Warfare 4, and that means that Permanent Unlock Tokens are coming back as well. If you’re unfamiliar with how Prestige Mode works, it resets your level back to one, but you receive a Permanent Unlock Token that you can use on any class item in multiplayer in exchange.
This is a huge benefit, as it lets you permanently unlock an item so you never have to unlock it again during the entire Prestige grind in Modern Warfare 4. However, with so many items to choose from, which unlock gives you the best bang for your buck?
Below, we’ll give you five distinct class items in MW4 multiplayer that are most worth spending a Permanent Unlock Token on after you Prestige. The item list is in order from 1-5.
Table of contents
1. Stim (unlocked at level 47)
2. Axion (unlocked at level 52)
3. Ninja (unlocked at level 30)
4. Cronen Squall (unlocked at level 55)
5. Gunship (unlocked at level 51)
1. Stim (unlocked at level 47)
Image via Activision
First on the list has to be the Stim, which is a piece of Tactical Equipment that quickly heals you back to full health when applied. The Stim is unlocked at level 47 in MW4 multiplayer, making it one of the final items you’ll unlock every single Prestige.
While there are other solid pieces of Tactical Equipment you can use until that level, once you get used to the Stim, there’s really no going back. The ability to get back into the fight instantly after being injured, compared to waiting for several seconds to recoup health, is one of the most important benefits of any item in multiplayer. If you use a Permanent Unlock Token on the Stim, your Tactical slot is pretty much set in stone on all loadouts in multiplayer.
2. Axion (unlocked at level 52)
Image via Activision
Next up, we have the Axion assault rifle, which is unlocked at level 52. The Axion is one of the best assault rifles in Modern Warfare 4, and having it available for only three levels every Prestige is ultimately a waste of its potential. This is arguably a top meta weapon in multiplayer, so you’ll want it permanently unlocked as soon as possible.
It should be noted, though, that there is an Axion blueprint available through the Monster Energy rewards in MW4. If you have the blueprint, you don’t ever have to worry about unlocking the Axion, as the blueprint gives you permanent access to the AR. So, if you have that blueprint, you don’t have any need to use an unlock token on the Axion.
3. Ninja (unlocked at level 30)
Image via Activision
At first glance, you might be questioning why we have Ninja on this list. After all, it’s only unlocked at level 30, and with some Double XP Tokens, you’ll be able to reach that level in no time. However, if you look at the list of unlocks in multiplayer, there’s not a lot else worth using a Permanent Unlock Token on.
And with how useful Ninja is, especially given the footstep volume in MW4, it’s a worthwhile item to unlock even if it is earned earlier than other items. Being able to always have your footsteps be silent is massive for any playstyle, so Ninja is definitely worth the token.
4. Cronen Squall (unlocked at level 55)
Image via Activision
Our penultimate item to use a Permanent Unlock Token on is the Cronen Squall, another assault rifle. The Cronen Squall, last seen in MWII (2022), is the final unlock in multiplayer, earned at level 55. While the Cronen Squall doesn’t look to be the absolute best weapon in MW4, it’s always worth having the final unlocked weapon available at all times.
Whether you’re grinding for all the Mastery Camos or trying to level up weapons faster in MW4, you want most high-level weapons unlocked so you always have access to them. If you don’t use a token on the Cronen Squall, then you’ll only get to use it for a few matches before Prestiging again and re-locking the weapon.
5. Gunship (unlocked at level 51)
Image via Activision
Finally, there’s the Gunship, which is one of the best overall killstreaks in MW4 multiplayer. As is usually the case with a streak of this magnitude, you won’t unlock the Gunship until level 51, which doesn’t leave you much time to use it before you have to enter a new Prestige.
The Gunship shouldn’t be one of the first items you use a Permanent Unlock Token on, but it should absolutely be in consideration early on. It’s a 12-kill streak that can devastate any map in multiplayer, and while it won’t help you towards earning the Nuke killstreak, it’s well worth permanently unlocking before you reach Prestige Master.

items.title: How to get Ledge Hanging Kills in Modern Warfare 4

Plenty of weapon camo challenges have become a pain in the sides of Call of Duty: Modern Warfare 4 players everywhere, but none more than earning Ledge Hanging Kills. You need these kills specifically to unlock a camo for the Krait P68 pistol, and even though you only need 15 of them, it can feel like this challenge is impossible in multiplayer.
Fortunately, thanks to the release of some post-launch content in MW4, Ledge Hanging Kills aren’t an issue at all. So, if you want to see exactly how to earn Ledge Hanging Kills quickly, check out the guide below.
Key Takeaways
Ledge Hanging Kills are required for a camo challenge on the Krait P68 pistol
You can earn these kills in both multiplayer and DMZ, but one specific method makes it far easier in multiplayer
You’ll have to play on the Shipment map in MW4 to do this specific method for earning Ledge Hanging Kills
Table of contents
Key Takeaways
How to earn Hanging Ledge Kills in Modern Warfare 4
How to earn Hanging Ledge Kills in Modern Warfare 4
Ledge Hanging Kills require you to mantle halfway up an object, hang in the air, and then use your gun in a single hand to kill enemies. This is extremely difficult on its own, as there really aren’t that many objects that can be ledge-hung from on multiplayer maps in MW4.
However, there is one major exception to this rule. On the map Shipment, there are some red crates on the side of the map near the wooden pallets and ruined car. On either side of these red crates, you can jump up to the middle ledge and hang from it. You can see us performing the ledge hang from the red crate in the screenshot below.
From this position, you need to wait for enemies to come around the corner in front of you or from the crate’s exit right below you. Either way, you’ll be able to kill them fairly easily from this position, as no enemy expects you to be hanging off the side of the crate.
Of course, once you get a kill in this position, enemies will likely hunt you down, so it’s wise to move to different sides of the red crate to cause some confusion. In any case, though, you now have a bona fide spot to earn your Ledge Hanging Kills in Modern Warfare 4.
To ensure you get the best chance to play on Shipment, you can currently hop into the “Shransit” playlist or wait for the “Shipment 24/7” playlist to return to multiplayer. The Shransit playlist contains Transit 213, Shoot House, and Shipment in a variety of game modes.
You won’t be able to get too many kills per Shipment match, but within a few matches, you’ll have this Krait P68 camo challenge completed. With that challenge out of the way, make sure you also know the best ways to get Longshot Kills and Point Blank Kills in MW4.

items.title: How to win this week’s Hearthstone Tavern Brawl: The Dark Wanderer decks and guide
items.content:
Diablo has entered this week’s Hearthstone Tavern Brawl. Defeating him results in a free card pack and, if you haven’t already completed this Tavern Brawl in the past, the Secret Level card back. Here’s our guide on how to claim victory plus some The Dark Wanderer decks and deck codes.
The Secret Level card back in Hearthstone (Image credit: esports.gg)
Hearthstone The Dark Wanderer Tavern Brawl guide
The Dark Wanderer is a Tavern Brawl that requires you to build your own deck. Since this game mode is under the Wild format, you don’t have to only use Standard cards. When you first jump into the fray, you must face The Dark Wanderer. After getting his 50 health down to 0, he gets replaced by Diablo. This time, your opponent has 150 health.
We milled The Dark Wanderer with our Dead Man’s Hand Warrior deck (Image credit: esports.gg)
It can feel devastating when you see Diablo after a hard-fought victory against The Dark Wanderer. It may even feel impossible as you must begin the Diablo fight with double the damage to your face.
Diablo appeared, but Garrosh’s job was done (Image credit: esports.gg)
However, what’s nice about this Tavern Brawl is that you can chip away at Diablo’s health in multiple matches. For example, after we defeated The Dark Wanderer with our Dead Man’s Hand Warrior deck, we started another match with our Mech Paladin one. This match resulted in Diablo having 123 health left, as seen in our screenshot below.
Sylvanas going face (Image credit: esports.gg)
We then alternated between Face Hunter and a makeshift Mage deck full of spells to the face to achieve lethal faster. Eventually, Diablo’s health went down to 0, granting us a free Reign of the Black Empire card pack.
It’s Medivh time (Image credit: esports.gg)
Hearthstone Tavern Brawl: The Dark Wanderer decks (F2P)
As noted, we used Dead Man’s Hand Warrior to defeat The Dark Wanderer and then fought Diablo with Face Hunter, Mech Paladin, and a Mage deck loaded with spells to the face. We chose the first three decks simply because we enjoy piloting them and already have all the cards in our collection.
You can do the same with decks you’re familiar with or try out other options such as ntoal97’s Control Warrior, SaigonTimeMD’s Egg Paladin, or Carsizzle’s Dragon Pirate Warrior.
The chalkboard for this week’s Tavern Brawl (Image credit: esports.gg)

Steam now shows real-world FPS data for Steam Deck games
items.content:
Valve has rolled out a new Steam feature that displays real-world performance data for Steam Deck games, giving players access to crowd-sourced average framerate information before they buy.
Steam Deck owners can now view average FPS figures directly on supported game store pages by selecting the “Learn More” option under the Steam Deck Compatibility section. The data is sourced from players who have opted in to anonymous framerate reporting, with Valve confirming that thousands of games already have performance information available.
The new performance tools go beyond a simple average framerate figure. Steam now includes a detailed histogram showing the percentage of playtime spent at different frame rates, helping users identify potential stuttering issues and get a better picture of how consistently a game performs on Steam Deck hardware.
According to Valve, the feature was introduced because the existing Steam Deck Verified system doesn't always reflect individual performance expectations. While some players are perfectly happy with a game running at 30FPS, others may prefer a more consistent 60FPS experience. The additional performance data allows users to make their own judgement before purchasing a game.
Valve says the information is filtered using data collected from Steam Deck systems running at default frame limit settings to maintain consistency across reported results. The company has also confirmed plans to expand similar performance reporting beyond Steam Deck in the future. We could potentially see this same system put in place for the Steam Machine, and Valve could potentially expand the system to include commonly used PC graphics cards or laptop GPUs, displaying the correct result to the user based on the device they are running.
KitGuru says: Having access to real-world performance data directly on a game's store page removes a lot of the guesswork. Is this a feature you'll start using before buying games for your Steam Deck?

Vidit Gujrathi joins Team Apex Gaming as it expands into Chess
items.content:
The Indian Grandmaster becomes the organisation's first chess signing as it continues to expand beyond mobile esports. (Photo credit: Chessbase India)
Indian grandmaster Vidit Gujrathi has joined Team Apex Gaming, marking the esports organisation's entry into chess and adding another title to its expanding competitive portfolio.
The announcement was made on November 9, with Team Apex Gaming welcoming the 31-year-old through a social media post that read: “Every great game needs a Grandmaster. Ours just arrived. Welcome, Vidit Gujrathi.”
Vidit also confirmed the move on X, writing: “Happy to be part of Team Apex Gaming. Let's kill it!”
The signing makes Vidit the organisation's first chess player. However, neither Team Apex Gaming nor the grandmaster has disclosed the financial terms, duration of the agreement, or the specific responsibilities attached to the deal. It also remains unclear whether his role will focus on competitive tournaments, content creation, or both.
Founded in April 2026 by popular BGMI player and content creator Jonathan Amaral, better known as Jonathan Gaming, Team Apex Gaming has been expanding beyond its initial focus on mobile esports. The organisation has added Free Fire and EA Sports FC Mobile to its portfolio, with Vidit's signing now bringing chess into the mix.
For Vidit, the move adds an esports organisation to a career that has combined elite-level competition with streaming and digital content. He became a Grandmaster in 2013 and won the FIDE Grand Swiss in 2023, earning qualification for the 2024 Candidates Tournament in Toronto. He has also won two gold medals with India's team at the Chess Olympiad in 2022 and 2024.
His association with esports is not entirely new. Earlier in 2026, Vidit reached the final of India Rising, the qualifier for the chess competition at the Esports World Cup, but lost to Dutch Grandmaster Benjamin Bok in an Armageddon tiebreak.
The signing also reflects the growing overlap between traditional chess and the esports ecosystem, where competitive play, livestreaming and creator-led audiences increasingly intersect.
Team Apex Gaming's expansion comes as other esports organisations also build chess divisions. S8UL has previously signed Indian grandmasters Nihal Sarin and Aravindh Chithambaram, while Arjun Erigaisi represents Gen.G.
Vidit's arrival gives Team Apex Gaming an established name in international chess as it looks to broaden its presence across competitive gaming. The organisation has yet to announce its first tournament or appearance under the TAG banner.

items.title: Tekken Boss Katsuhiro Harada Says Developing For Xbox Series S ‘Feels Like Having To Do Extra Work For A Slightly Weaker Child’
How Luma Island Was Built For Everyone on XBOX Series X|S
items.content:
Hello, XBOX community! We’re Feel Free Games, an independent videogame development team based in the Netherlands. We’d like to introduce you to Luma Island, our debut title, launched on PC in 2024. Reception and positive review scores from fans around the globe blew us away, to date more than 800,000 PC players have set foot on our shores and now, we’re thrilled to be bringing Luma Island to XBOX Series X|S on December 2, complete with full cross-platform multiplayer.
Our studio background isn’t typical for the games industry. Many of us built our careers in 3D software, most recently in architectural visualization, but games have always been our passion. Having a game studio of our own is a lifelong dream come true. That background naturally shaped our approach to rich environmental detail, tactile building systems, and lighting. But when it came to designing the core gameplay loop of Luma Island, our guiding light wasn’t just industry conventions, it was the people in our lives.
From the very beginning, we wanted to create an adventure we could share not only with seasoned gaming friends, but also with our kids, our parents, and family members who rarely pick up a controller. Every major design decision came back to a simple question: Would they enjoy this, too?
Traditional simulation and survival gameplay mechanics often include barriers for casual players. When an inventory fills up, or when a stamina meter drains after chopping three trees, momentum grinds to a halt. We decided to strip those blockers away.
In Luma Island, there are no stamina bars, no inventory limits, and no ticking clocks forcing you into bed. If someone in your party wants to spend the afternoon tending crops and decorating the homestead, they can do so uninterrupted. If someone else wants to plunge into deep cavern networks, dodge ancient temple traps, and solve environmental puzzles, they have complete freedom to do so.
To make sure everyone can play at their own comfort level, we built three tailored game modes:
Cozy Mode: Completely peaceful exploration where combat only happens if you actively choose it.
Adventure Mode: A balanced blend of discovery, light peril, and rewarding puzzle-solving.
Hero Mode: Faster, tougher enemies and demanding encounters designed specifically for seasoned gamers.
While the cozy farmstead is your anchor, Luma Island quickly opens into a sprawling, mysterious wilderness across four biomes: Farm, Forest, Mountain, Jungle and Pirate Cove. Each biome features its own temples.
Instead of heavy tutorials, the game invites you to follow your curiosity through the mastering of distinct professions. Players can specialize in jobs like Archaeologist, Blacksmith, Brewer, Cook, Fisherman, Jeweler, Shipwright, or Treasure Hunter. Each profession brings unique recipes, specialized tools, and distinct goals, meaning every player in your group can carve out an essential role in your shared community.
And, of course, there are the island’s namesakes: the Lumas. These magical companions are hatched from mysterious eggs found scattered across the wilderness. Beyond being undeniably adorable, your bonded Luma accompanies you on your expeditions, fighting nearby enemies or alerting you to hidden artifacts buried beneath the soil.
Seeing parents, kids, and friends of entirely different gaming backgrounds team up to play Luma Island has been the most rewarding part of this journey. Bringing that experience to Xbox felt like the natural next step.
We have fully tailored Luma Island for the XBOX Series X|S experience, featuring responsive controller layouts, a full suite of Xbox Achievements to hunt, and, most importantly, seamless day-one cross-platform play. Up to four players can explore, build, and venture into the depths together across all available platforms.
Whether you’re organizing a four-player squad expedition or looking for an inviting world to explore with someone who has never touched a controller before, Luma Island is ready to welcome you when it launches on XBOX Series X|S on December 2.
Store pages are live now – add Luma Island to your XBOX wishlist now, and we’ll see you on the island!

items.title: Zelda Ocarina of Time Remake off to record-breaking start with 5.2 million sales
items.content:
Nintendo has announced that The Legend of Zelda: Ocarina of Time Remake has sold more than 5.2 million copies worldwide in just four days, making it the fastest-selling Nintendo-published game on Nintendo Switch 2 to date.
The remake launched on the 5th of November and has already surpassed 5.2 million units sold worldwide, including 810,000 copies in Japan alone. The record-setting sales followed on from a wave of positive reviews, with critics praising Nintendo's reimagining of one of the most influential games ever made.
Originally released for the Nintendo 64 in 1998, The Legend of Zelda: Ocarina of Time is widely regarded as one of the most important games in Nintendo's history. The Switch 2 remake retains everything players loved about the original, but with vastly improved graphics and some other gameplay modernisations such as power and weapon cycling borrowed from Breath of the Wild.
The launch result also marks a milestone for Nintendo's latest console, with Ocarina of Time becoming the highest-selling Nintendo-published Nintendo Switch 2 title during its first four days on sale. Given both the game's critical reception and the enduring popularity of the Zelda franchise, the strong start is unlikely to come as much of a surprise.

Sentinels part ways with cortezia and Reduxx, rebuild around brawk and OXY for 2027
items.content:
Sentinels mean business going into 2027. They’ve parted ways with initiator cortezia and Reduxx, with both players now unrestricted free agents. The org is moving full-pelt with a largely rebuilt 2027 VALORANT Champions Tour lineup for the new Americas partnership cycle, at the heart of which will be new signing Francis “OXY” Hoang.
CEO Rob Moore confirmed both cortezia and Reduxx were told about their release a week earlier. It gives cortezia time to plan his move back to Brazil, where he's reportedly already agreed a verbal deal to join LOUD. The shake-up comes in the aftermath of a bad season for Sentinels, who failed to qualify for Masters Santiago, Masters London or Champions Shanghai this year. The org also saw a number of content creators turn their backs on them, while various line-up changes has hindered their efforts.
Revenue was up at least, with Sentinels reporting $6.4 million growth earlier this spring.
What cortezia and Reduxx said on the way out
Cortezia recorded a farewell video from his Los Angeles apartment before flying home. He made clear the call came from Sentinels, not from him, and that he'd wanted at least one more year with the American org. He thanked former head coach kaplan (who left the org in February this year), assistant coach Gunter, his agent Gabe, and Moore.
Reduxx's exit is a bit of a surprise. Described by many as a “prodigy”, his exit brings to an end a two-year run that took him from Cubert Academy to the VCT main stage. Despite still being only 19, the duellist took responsibility for the team's results in 2026 and described the stretch as a foundation he'll personally build on. The org's send-off, "Tracing his journey from Seattle," credited him with embodying what a Sentinel should be.
The new core is already in place
Here’s what the 2027 Sentinels roster currently looks like:
PlayerBackgroundStatus
Francis "OXY" HoangFormerly of Cloud9Signed
Brock "brawk" SomerhalderChampions 2025 MVP out of NRGSigned
canezerraAscension championOn board
JohnqtIGL, the player who calls the team's strategyJoins the new group
KeikoFormer NRG playerExpected to fill the fifth spot, not confirmed
Writer's take
Thank you @NotReduxx
From the centerpiece of our academy roster to the hero of the main stage, you’ve embodied what it means to be a Sentinel every step of the way
The future is bright, and you’re just getting started https://t.co/0Z7D2CvCwj
— Sentinels (@Sentinels) November 10, 2026
Two straight-up league-wide names plus an MVP is a real statement of intent from an org that needs a good year in 2027. Sentinels swapped the whole supporting cast around Johnqt in one window, which is a pretty big bet to place on instant chemistry. Some caution is warranted around canezerra, though; this is his first stint at the top level and he’ll have to find a way to handle the pressure.
Fans seem upbeat, with plenty calling the group a stacked lineup on paper and one of several “superteams” currently shaping the North America VALORANT scene.
What's next
Sentinels haven't named an official fifth player, so a Keiko confirmation is the next piece to watch before the 2027 VCT season gets going. cortezia's move to LOUD also hasn't been officially announced.

items.title: Final Fantasy 14: Evercold looks set to overhaul progression and rewards
items.content:
Square Enix has revealed a host of new details for Final Fantasy XIV: Evercold, but beyond the new job reveals and expansion trailer, the biggest changes appear aimed at giving players more freedom in how they progress through the game.
While Evercold will introduce new areas, raids and jobs, many long-time players have been paying closer attention to the expansion's major systems changes. Perhaps the most significant is a complete overhaul of progression and rewards. Square Enix is introducing a new Adventurer Activity system that broadens the ways players can earn equipment, while shifting reward structures away from strict daily engagement.
Instead, Evercold will place greater emphasis on weekly progression, while also allowing players to catch up on rewards missed from previous weeks. For players who don't have time to log in every day, the changes could significantly reduce the fear of falling behind friends or raid groups.
Progression isn't the only area seeing changes. Players will be able to tackle certain areas of the main story in different orders, aided by automatic content scaling that adjusts combat difficulty and rewards to suit character progression. Meanwhile, Evercold's new Evolved Mode offers redesigned job gameplay intended to further emphasise each class's identity, while the existing combat system will remain available through Reborn Mode.
Group content is seeing major changes too. Square Enix is introducing a new “Fierce” difficulty that sits between Normal and Savage encounters, providing an extra stepping stone for players not yet ready for the game's most demanding content. Alliance raids are also being reworked, with 24-player content split into multiple routes rather than a single linear experience.
Of course, Evercold isn't short on traditional expansion content either. The expansion introduces Zephyr, a new physical ranged DPS job that fights using a crossbow alongside an avian companion known as Nephele. Players will also take on the Beyond the Lifestream raid series, a crossover with Final Fantasy VII Remake, while EVANGELION: Ghosts of Desire will bring new alliance raid content inspired by the iconic anime franchise. Expanded character customisation options, housing improvements, PvP updates and a revamped chocobo system are also planned.

PRO – Seven pre-installed LINK FAN INF 120 fans plus a loose-packed LUMI hub/controller.
Specification:
Motherboard support: ATX, Micro-ATX, Mini-ITX with support for rear connection.
Power supply support: ATX, SFX-L, SFX.
Expansion slots: 7.
Included fans: 3x 120mm bottom intake, 2x 120mm side intake, 2x 120mm rear exhaust. All Link Fan INF 120.
Fan mounts: 5x 120mm side, 2x 120mm rear, 3x 120mm floor.
Radiator mounts: 360mm and 240mm side, 120mm rear.
5.25-inch optical drive bays: None.
Internal drive bays: 1x 3.5-inch, 2x 2.5-inch.
Front I/O ports: 2x USB 3.0 Type-A, 1x USB 3.1 2 Gen 2 Type-C, audio.
Dimensions: 534mm H x 480mm D x 300mm W.
Testing
To put this case through its cooling paces we will be using a test system consisting of an AMD Ryzen 7 9850X3D processor, a Palit RTX 5080 graphic card and an SSD. This system allows us to produce a substantial amount of heat and effectively test the Montech King 95 3D‘s cooling capabilities.
Test System:
Processor: AMD Ryzen 7 9850X3D
CPU Cooler: Montech CyberFlow ARGB 360
Motherboard: MSI MAG X870E Tomahawk Max WiFi PZ
Memory: 32GB G.Skill Trident Z5 NeoX RGB DDR5-6000
Graphics card: Palit GeForce RTX 5080 GameRock OC
Power supply: Montech Titan PLA 1000W
SSD: Crucial T700 Gen 5 M.2 NVMe
OS: Windows 11
Cooling Performance
Cooling Performance Overview
We were concerned the Montech King 95 3D Pro might struggle under heavy load as glass panels are notorious for choking airflow, however it worked quite well in practice. We used smoke to visualise the airflow and it is clear that air coming in through the side fans heads directly to the AIO cooler mounted in the novel side location. It was less clear whether air coming through the graphics card was exhausted to the rear or fed up to the AIO cooler but the overall result was good.
Closing Thoughts
The changes that Montech made to the original King 95 to create the King 95 3D are all about the glass top panel. The 3D is 90mm taller than the original case to accommodate a 360mm AIO cooler in the right-hand side, effectively rotated 90 degrees from the usual location.
This opens up space at the rear of the case so Montech has installed two 120mm fans instead of the usual one, and thus we end up with a dual-chamber case with loads of glass and also with the potential to flow air.
We like the 3D part of the King 95 but we really like the Pro package that includes seven of Montech's new Link Fan INF 120s which deliver a superb light show. We have seen similar fans from other manufacturers and are very pleased that Montech has got on board with this infinity mirror technology.
When you add these features together you end up with a PC case unlike anything we have seen before.
You will be able to buy the Montech King 95 3D for $199.99.
Pros:
The King 95 3D Pro gives you a fantastic RGB light show.
Montech has found a way to use three glass panels and still cool the internals.
Cons:
Graphics card will overshadow cable headers on conventional motherboards.
With a Rear-Connect motherboard you have plenty of cables to tuck away.
Panel removal is slightly fiddly.
Cable management is basic.
KitGuru says: The Montech King 95 3D Pro delivers mega levels of bling.

items.title: Ocypus launches 360mm AIO cooler that physically opens up to cool VRMs
items.content:
Ocypus has unveiled the limited-edition Omega L36 Ultra, a 360mm AIO liquid cooler that physically expands under heavy CPU loads to provide additional airflow over motherboard VRMs. While this is a very unique feature, production is limited to just 200 units worldwide.
The Omega L36 Ultra's standout feature is its dynamic cooling system. Under heavy CPU loads, the pump housing raises its integrated display while a set of side panels expand outward. This activates a dedicated internal fan that directs airflow towards motherboard VRM heatsinks, with Ocypus claiming temperature reductions of up to 10°C. Users can also configure the CPU temperature threshold that triggers the mechanism through the Ocypus Display software.
Customisation is another major focus. A 2.8-inch IPS display sits atop the pump block, allowing users to display system stats or custom videos, GIFs or graphics. The 480×480 display is surrounded by 360-degree ARGB lighting and can be configured through Ocypus' companion software.
Cooling hardware remains fairly high-end throughout. The cooler uses a ceramic-bearing pump rated for up to 3100RPM alongside a copper coldplate featuring micron-scale microchannels. A pre-installed Sigma F36 ARGB fan assembly handles airflow duties across the 360mm radiator, while an included adapter allows users to reduce maximum fan speeds from 2200RPM to 1900RPM for quieter operation.
Beyond the motorised cooling system, the Omega L36 Ultra is also being positioned as a collector's item. Each unit features CNC-machined aluminium construction, an anodised sandblasted finish, an engraved metal authentication card and an individual serial number. Ocypus is limiting production to 200 units worldwide and has set pricing at $399.99. The cooler is compatible with Intel LGA 115X, 1200, 1700, 1851 and AMD AM4 and AM5 platforms.
KitGuru says: AIO coolers rarely do anything genuinely different these days, so a design that physically opens under load certainly stands out. Is this innovation or just an expensive gimmick?

items.title: CHIEFTEC introduces new ATLAS E-ATX case for workstation builds
items.content:
CHIEFTEC has introduced the new ATLAS workstation chassis, a full-sized E-ATX case designed for workstation-grade systems requiring extensive expansion options, large cooling configurations and support for multiple large GPUs.
Expansion is one of the ATLAS's key selling points. The chassis supports Mini-ITX, mATX, ATX and E-ATX motherboards and offers eight PCIe expansion slots for multi-GPU configurations. Graphics cards up to 450mm long are supported, while storage options include room for up to five 3.5-inch drives alongside additional 2.5-inch SSD mounting positions.
Cooling is another major focus. The ATLAS ships with four pre-installed 140mm PWM fans and supports radiators up to 420mm in both the front and top of the chassis. Additional fan mounts are available throughout the case, including the PSU shroud, side panel area and a dedicated PCIe fan bracket that can be used to improve airflow around expansion cards.
CHIEFTEC has also included a removable E-ATX motherboard backplate to simplify system assembly and maintenance. Front I/O consists of a USB 3.2 Gen 2 Type-C port, two USB 3.0 ports, two USB 2.0 ports and HD audio connectivity.
Unfortunately, there is one key detail we don't have yet – pricing / availability, but we will update this page once we have retail listings.

Sony is discontinuing its PlayStation Plus streaming app on PC
items.content:
Though you might be surprised to hear it, Sony has for many years offered a way for PlayStation Plus subscribers to stream games on PC via a dedicated app. First launched back in 2016 during the old-defunct PS Now days, the service had seen little in the way of updates / improvements, being limited to streaming just PS3/4 titles. As such, it comes as little surprise that the console maker is now discontinuing the service, officially announcing that the PlayStation Plus app on PC will soon no longer be accessible.
Taking to the PlayStation Blog to make the announcement, Sony informed users that their decade-old PlayStation Plus streaming app for PC will soon be no more, writing:
“We wanted to let you know that from December 10, we will be retiring the PlayStation Plus app on PC. PlayStation believes in providing high-quality experiences to our players, and we regularly review offerings to ensure we are focusing on experiences our members value most.“
According to Sony, just 0.4% of PS Plus Premium subscribers made use of the PC app, and so it isn’t too surprising to see the service being discontinued.
Initially launched back in 2016, the app did receive a few updates over the years, most notably bringing support for PS4 streaming in 2017. Since then however, little was changed / improved upon, with PS5 support never coming to fruition on the PC side of things.
So, while the discontinuation of the PS Plus app for PC is ultimately not too big of a loss (except for the 0.4% of subscribers who used it), this seems to represent yet another move by Sony to distance itself from the PC platform. Their full statement on the matter can be found HERE.

November’s PlayStation Plus Extra line-up include Death Standing 2; Atomfall and more
items.content:
Each month, Sony updates its PlayStation Plus Extra / Premium line-ups with new and (sometimes) returning games. For the penultimate month of 2026, the console maker is introducing a total of 10 titles to the service, including the likes of Death Stranding 2: On the Beach, Atomfall, Like a Dragon: Pirate Yakuza in Hawaii and more.
As has been the case for a few months now, November’s PlayStation Plus Extra / Premium line-up will be released in a staggered form (at least in the US, UK and Japan), with all other regions getting the full line-up on the 17th of November:
Available today:
Hell Let Loose
17th November:
Death Stranding 2: On the Beach
Atomfall
Dragon Quest III HD-2D Remake
Soul Reaver 2 [PS Plus Premium]
Freedom Wars Remastered [PS Plus Premium]
24th November:
Like a Dragon: Pirate Yakuza in Hawaii
Trepang2
MotoGP 26
Cricket 26 – The Official Game of the Ashes
The headliner for this month is easily Death Stranding 2: On the Beach. Released back in June of 2025 as a PS5 exclusive (followed up by a PC port earlier this year), the sequel to Kojima’s contentious-yet-excellent ‘walking simulator’ proved to be a critical hit, amassing near universal acclaim owing to its improvements across both the game’s narrative as well as a vast expansion on the gameplay front. Though not for everyone, Death Stranding (and its sequel) are highly evocative and memorable experiences worth checking out.
Another notable addition is Atomfall. Though far less celebrated than DS2, this first-person survival-action game is a marked departure from Rebellion Developments’ past work on the Sniper Elite series. Set in an alternate history version of 1960s England (and inspired by Fallout New Vegas), Atomfall was praised for its focus on freeform exploration and mystery, necessitating players to piece the puzzle together one bit at a time. While not all is perfect, being able to approach different situations in alternate ways – in combination with its open-zone nature and unique setting – makes for a world worth exploring.
In case you missed it, Sony also announced its list of titles which are set to leave PlayStation Plus Extra later this month, the full list of which can be found HERE.

items.title: GTA V has officially sold 235 million copies
items.content:
It’s been 13 years since the original release of Grand Theft Auto V and yet Rockstar’s evergreen title has continued to consistently sell like hotcakes. With the long-awaited GTA VI just over a week away from launch, publisher Take-Two has come out and given updated sales stats for the ageing giant, revealing that GTA V has sold just shy of 235 million copies.
As part of Take-Two's recent earnings report, the publisher offered final sales stats for its past releases ahead of the juggernaut that is Grand Theft Auto VI.
With regards to their most recent title, Take-Two announced that Red Dead Redemption 2 has sold a total of 89 million copies since its launch in 2018 – putting it as the 3rd or 4th best-selling game of all time (depending on whether you include the iconic Tetris and its various releases in the rankings).
GTA V meanwhile resides within multiple tiers above even RDR2, with Take-Two confirming that the 2013 cultural giant has officially reached “nearly 235 million units sold to date” putting it as the 2nd or 3rd best-selling game of all time (again, depending on whether you count Tetris).
Given that GTA V has consistently sold an additional 5 million units every quarter for years now, it is safe to assume that the title will eventually hit a quarter of a Billion copies sold when all is said and done. That being said, with Grand Theft Auto VI just over a week away from release, it will be interesting to see whether GTA V will finally slow down in the sales department. Next Quarter’s report will be an interesting one to say the least.

items.content:
Mark's enthusiasm for computers dampened at an early age by the rubber-keyed Sinclair Spectrum 48K and feelings of Commodore 64 envy. However, in the mid-80s, hope in a digital future was rekindled by the purchase of an Atari 520 STe. Since that time Mark has used a multitude of computers for fun and professional endeavors. He often owned both Macs and PCs but went cold on the former after OS9 was killed off, and warmed to the latter with the introduction of Windows XP.

Early work years were spent in artwork and reprographics but in the late noughties, Mark started to blog about computers, Taiwanese food culture, and guitar design. This activity led to a full-time position writing about breaking PC tech news for HEXUS, for the best part of a decade. When HEXUS was abruptly closed, Mark helped with the foundation of Club386, before finding a new home at Tom's Hardware.

When not wearing through the keycap legends on his PC keyboards, Mark can be found wandering the computer malls of Taiwan's neon-lit conurbations and enjoying local and international cuisine.

GTA VI breaks pre-order records on both PlayStation and Xbox
items.content:
In the lead up to the release of Rockstar’s Grand Theft Auto VI, we’ve seen various analysts and reports offering early details regarding just how well the upcoming open-world juggernaut has been performing when it comes to pre-order numbers. Though official figures have not been shared, both PlayStation and Xbox have now revealed that – unsurprisingly – GTA VI has managed to become the most pre-ordered game in either platform’s history.
With GTA VI just a week away from release, Rockstar Games and its partners have finally begun to speak more openly about the upcoming and long-awaited industry giant, recently confirming some of the the game’s technical specifications across PlayStation 5 and Xbox Series X|S.
Taking to the PlayStation Blog to discuss its PS5-specific features (such as adaptive trigger and PS5 Pro support), Sony revealed that GTA VI is already breaking records for the platform, writing:
“Grand Theft Auto VI is now the most pre-ordered game in the history of PlayStation Store. Given this unprecedented demand, we’ve joined with Rockstar Games to allow players to start pre-loading the game nine days early, so they’re ready to play on launch day.”
Mirroring this sentiment, Microsoft took to their own Xbox Wire blog to reveal that GTA VI has become “the most pre-ordered title of all time on the Microsoft Store.”
Both Microsoft and PlayStation are typically silent on such matters, and so it is tough to compare these claims to past releases. That said, being the most pre-ordered game of all time across both platforms is a massive achievement regardless – especially as the undisclosed figure is likely to balloon further over the next week as we approach its 19th of November release date.
Given that 2013’s Grand Theft Auto V ended up selling more than 11 million copies in its first 24 hours, it is safe to assume that GTA VI will exceed this figure by quite a wide margin. We won’t have to wait long to find out.

items.title: MSI unveils 360Hz MEG X ultrawide with 5th-gen QD-OLED panel
items.content:
MSI has introduced the MEG X, a flagship 34-inch ultrawide gaming monitor combining a 360Hz refresh rate, a 5th-generation QD-OLED panel and a range of gaming-focused software features.
Image quality is one of the MEG X's biggest selling points. The 3440×1440 ultrawide uses the very latest Penta Tandem QD-OLED technology, which is claimed to improve light efficiency by up to 30% compared to previous generations. The panel also adopts an RGB Stripe sub-pixel layout to help reduce colour fringing, and you'll benefit from DisplayHDR True Black 500 and ClearMR 18000 too.
MSI is also leaning heavily into gaming enhancements. An onboard processor handles a variety of features locally without requiring additional PC software, including AI Vision+, AI Crosshair and AI Super Resolution. The company has also added AI Gauge, which can display in-game health information through the monitor's front-facing SpectrumBar+ lighting strip. As you would expect from a modern OLED monitor, OLED Care features are also in place to keep your panel protected from burn-in over the long-term. The RGB lighting on the monitor can also be synchronised with other MSI components through Glow Sync+.
Connectivity remains firmly in flagship territory. The MEG X includes full-bandwidth DisplayPort 2.1a with UHBR20 support delivering up to 80Gbps, alongside HDMI 2.1 and USB Type-C connectivity with up to 98W Power Delivery.
